definition: below average in size or number
description: A car park by the sea. A bearded man in a flat cap and navy jacket pushes a bright red bubble car by hand out of a parking space; the little car is so low that it barely reaches his waist and it is dwarfed on both sides by two enormous black SUVs. He rolls it out, climbs in through the front and drives it along a coastal road, its three wheels and glass bubble roof tiny against the wide blue bay. He parks under a big spreading tree and sits on a bench beside it, with the city skyline across the water, then drives slowly away down the path.

de.answer: Er fährt ein kleines rotes Auto.
de.question: Was fährt der Mann?

es.answer: Está conduciendo un pequeño coche rojo.
es.question: ¿Qué está conduciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il conduit une petite voiture rouge.
fr.question: Que conduit l'homme ?
